method: Manual inspection of all three exact-restored photo pixel files; visual comparison, not metric survey, photogrammetry or quantitative image overlay.

column_count.basis: Views 0 and 1 separate four continuous shafts; the more frontal view 2 has overlapping rear shafts.

cap_edge_count.basis: Projected front eave folds and visible underside perimeter across all three views are treated as an octagonal cap.
cap_edge_count.confidence: bounded photo interpretation; no plan or dimension confirmation

openings: Central ring hole and spaces between columns remain open; not filled as a solid tower.
emblems: Only two visible positions approximated; no assertion that other sides are blank in reality.
preview_findings: All four original model previews visually inspected at full delivered size; model parts uncropped.
Front has red full fascia and white underside; no unsupported raised edge bead.
Four separate curved columns, open ring and two-tier base are visible; rear unconfirmed emblem positions remain unembellished.
Exploded view separates base, frame, cap and small bell; not a print plate layout.
